headline: Keep operational data private and all header controls reachable

items.title: Package only the canonical public served surface
items.insight: Operational state stays private while the website and advertised discovery remain available. Reuse the public-file classifier in staging and preserve advertised routes.
items.evidence: docs/S411_qa-release-findings-1108.json; current source and immutable before images.

items.title: Keep desktop navigation inside its container and snapshot neutral state
items.insight: Every header control remains visible and clickable across supported desktop themes; visual comparisons describe the intended neutral entry state. Compact desktop spacing and set a neutral snapshot pointer while preserving controls and tolerance.
